title: Understanding Drain Trap Seals
description: Drain traps are a critical component of every plumbing fixture, designed to hold a standing column of water that acts as a physical barrier against sewer gases entering living spaces. Maintaining this water seal relies on proper venting and trap design; if a trap loses its seal due to evaporation, siphonage, or back-pressure, foul odors and potentially hazardous gases can enter the building. Professional technicians regularly inspect trap assemblies, clean out plugs, and verify that fixture venting operates correctly to protect the trap seal integrity.

Understanding Drain Trap Seals

Drain traps are a critical component of every plumbing fixture, designed to hold a standing column of water that acts as a physical barrier against sewer gases entering living spaces. Maintaining this water seal relies on proper venting and trap design; if a trap loses its seal due to evaporation, siphonage, or back-pressure, foul odors and potentially hazardous gases can enter the building. Professional technicians regularly inspect trap assemblies, clean out plugs, and verify that fixture venting operates correctly to protect the trap seal integrity.
